question: What did the rematch-unsafe (date-less fighter-pair) settlement join actually decide, and what changed under the date-qualified boutId join?

repair.join: results decide ONLY via exact date-qualified boutId ('<commenceTime[:10]>:<sorted-normalized-pair>'), the id build_results.py already writes on all 1,545 result rows and build_features.py/build_schedule.py already derive
failClosed: odds bout without a derivable commenceTime date → pending + warning (never pair-only)
result row without a boutId → dropped from the index (can never decide)
duplicate boutId in results → pending + 'ambiguous boutId' warning
pair matches results ONLY on other dates → pending + explicit rematch-unsafe refusal warning; a row is NEVER picked

historicalAmbiguousRows.detail: Both decided rows carried boutId '2023-11-11:alex pereira|jiri prochazka' (Pereira win / Prochazka loss), but the odds being graded were CURRENT futures odds fetched 2026-06-09 for a hypothetical 2026-06-14 matchup. The date-less pair join silently attached the 2023-11-11 result to a bout that had not happened; the grade looked historical because the row was stamped with the RESULT's boutId and eventDate. Correct only by coincidence (Pereira also won the 2024-06-29 rematch).

whatChangedOnRegrade.inputs: committed app/public/data/ufc/odds-latest.json (2026-07-10, 20 bouts) + results-latest.json (2026-06-09, 1,545 rows) — fully offline, no fetches
whatChangedOnRegrade.note: The 2 previously 'decided' rows are gone: odds-latest.json moved on (2026-06-09 → 2026-07-10) so the Pereira/Prochazka hypothetical is no longer quoted, and the repaired join would have pended it anyway (no 2026-06-14 result exists). Zero decided rows is the honest state of this dataset.
whatChangedOnRegrade.liveDefectCaughtOnIdenticalInputs: Rerunning the OLD date-less join on today's committed inputs decides the FUTURE 2026-07-11 Henry Cejudo vs Merab Dvalishvili bout from the 2024-02-17 result (Dvalishvili win). The repaired join pends it with warning: "fighter pair has results on other dates ['2024-02-17']; date-less pair join refused (rematch-unsafe)".

backtestDatasetCorrection.note: Under the old pair join these 2 bouts would have become 4 leakage-corrupt backtest rows (futures odds joined to years-old results). rowCount stays 0 — still no bout with a same-date pregame snapshot AND a final result.

readinessConsequence.gradingReady: flips FALSE on the next build_readiness run: the grading gate requires >=1 win and >=1 loss in the graded artifact, and a correct grader currently has zero decided rows. This is the honest state — the previous 'true' rested entirely on the coincidence-graded Pereira/Prochazka pair.
readinessConsequence.staleCommittedArtifact: app/public/data/ufc/readiness-latest.json still records gradingReady=true from the pre-repair grade; it is regenerated by the ufc-results-refresh workflow (regeneration here would also flip oddsReady on 48h staleness — environmental, out of this lane's scope).

testsAdded: pipeline/ufc/grade_moneylines_test.py — opposite-winner rematch, same-winner repeat, NC-then-decided rematch, wrong-date refusal, missing commenceTime, missing/ambiguous boutId, name normalization, committed-artifact regression over all 10 colliding keys (wrong date can never decide; right date decides from its own row), mutation proof (date-less join reintroduced in-memory fails the rematch fixture; source byte-identical)
pipeline/ufc/build_backtest_dataset_test.py — rematch joins each bout to its own date, wrong-date pair excluded as date_mismatched_pair, result without boutId fails closed
